mapper.sql: s.id, s.legacy_place_group_id AS placeGroupId, s.representative_poi_id AS representativePoiId, s.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, s.name, s.short_name AS shortName, s.spot_type AS spotType, s.province, s.city, s.district, s.address, s.description, s.cover_image AS coverImage, s.longitude, s.latitude, s.location_radius_m AS locationRadiusM, s.rating, s.hotness, s.visit_count AS visitCount, s.status, pg.name AS placeGroupName, COALESCE(pg.route_graph_status, 'none') AS routeGraphStatus, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS poiCount, COUNT(DISTINCT str.tag_id) AS tagCount

WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.short_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.province LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.city LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pg.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND s.status = #{status}
AND COALESCE(pg.route_graph_status, 'none') = #{routeGraphStatus}
AND s.category_id IS NULL
AND (s.cover_image IS NULL OR s.cover_image = '')
AND (s.longitude IS NULL OR s.latitude IS NULL)
AND (s.short_name IS NULL OR s.short_name = '')
AND (s.description IS NULL OR s.description = '')
AND (s.address IS NULL OR s.address = '')
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM spot_tag_relations str WHERE str.spot_id = s.id )
AND ( s.representative_poi_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pois rp WHERE rp.id = s.representative_poi_id ) )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pois rp WHERE rp.id = s.representative_poi_id AND rp.status != 1 )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pois vp WHERE vp.spot_id = s.id AND vp.status = 1 AND COALESCE(vp.area_code, '') NOT IN ('route', 'campus_summary', 'spot_summary') )
AND s.spot_type IN ('campus', 'university') AND COALESCE(pg.route_graph_status, 'none') = 'none'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spots s LEFT JOIN place_groups pg ON pg.id = s.legacy_place_group_id

SELECT
FROM spots s LEFT JOIN place_groups pg ON pg.id = s.legacy_place_group_id LEFT JOIN poi_categories c ON c.id = s.category_id LEFT JOIN pois p ON p.spot_id = s.id AND p.status = 1 AND COALESCE(p.area_code, '') != 'route' AND COALESCE(p.area_code, '') != 'campus_summary' LEFT JOIN spot_tag_relations str ON str.spot_id = s.id WHERE s.id = #{id} GROUP BY s.id, s.legacy_place_group_id, s.representative_poi_id, s.category_id, c.name, s.name, s.short_name, s.spot_type, s.province, s.city, s.district, s.address, s.description, s.cover_image, s.longitude, s.latitude, s.location_radius_m, s.rating, s.hotness, s.visit_count, s.status, pg.name, pg.route_graph_status
SELECT id FROM poi_categories WHERE code = #{code} LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO pois (spot_id, poi_role, place_group_id, category_id, name, scene, area_code, area_name, province, city, address, location_text, description, image_url, longitude, latitude, rating, hotness, visit_count, status) VALUES (#{spotId}, 'spot_summary', #{placeGroupId}, #{request.categoryId}, #{request.name}, #{scene}, #{areaCode}, #{areaName}, #{request.province}, #{request.city}, #{request.address}, #{areaName}, #{request.description}, #{request.coverImage}, #{request.longitude}, #{request.latitude}, #{request.rating}, #{request.hotness}, 0, #{request.status})
mapper.update: UPDATE spots SET category_id = #{request.categoryId}, name = #{request.name}, short_name = #{request.shortName}, spot_type = #{request.spotType}, province = #{request.province}, city = #{request.city}, district = #{request.district}, address = #{request.address}, description = #{request.description}, cover_image = #{request.coverImage}, longitude = #{request.longitude}, latitude = #{request.latitude}, location_radius_m = #{request.locationRadiusM}, rating = #{request.rating}, hotness = #{request.hotness}, status = #{request.status} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE place_groups SET name = #{request.name}, short_name = #{request.shortName}, city = #{request.city}, district = #{request.district}, address = #{request.address}, longitude = #{request.longitude}, latitude = #{request.latitude}, route_graph_status = #{request.routeGraphStatus} WHERE id = #{placeGroupId}

UPDATE pois SET category_id = #{request.categoryId}, name = #{request.name}, scene = #{scene}, area_code = #{areaCode}, area_name = #{areaName}, province = #{request.province}, city = #{request.city}, address = #{request.address}, location_text = #{areaName}, description = #{request.description}, image_url = #{request.coverImage}, longitude = #{request.longitude}, latitude = #{request.latitude}, rating = #{request.rating}, hotness = #{request.hotness}, status = #{request.status} WHERE id = #{poiId} AND ( poi_role IN ('spot_summary', 'spot_legacy') OR area_code IN ('spot_summary', 'campus_summary') )
